invariants.rationale: The method throws an exception and never reaches exit if operationType is LOG_COMPACT, so this must always be false at METHOD_EXIT.
table is a required method parameter and must not be null for correct operation through method execution.
pendingCompactionTimeline is a method parameter and operations such as containsInstant are invoked on it.
operationType is dereferenced to call .equals, so it must not be null at this point.
instantTime is used to generate HoodieInstant objects and passed to methods, so it must not be null.
